title: wslua_tree: use standard structures in TreeItem_children
description:
Refactor `TreeItem:children()` implementation to be closer to standard
practices used in other wslua functions.

Replace custom stack implementation with `wmem_stack_t`.

Use wmem with `lua_pinfo->pool` instead of GLib memory allocation.

Check that the filter argument is a string or table of strings early in
the function, and if not, raise the error before memory is allocated.

Simplify checking the recursion argument.

Inspired by attempts to debug #21075 

AI-Assisted: no

notes.body:
You can't set `hfinfo` twice in the parameters of the function, because arguments are evaluated in an unspecified order without sequencing.

https://en.cppreference.com/c/language/operator_other#Function_call
https://en.cppreference.com/c/language/eval_order
I mean, you can, but it's UB what value `hfinfo` will have afterwards, which maybe you don't care about, but the clang tidy checks do.
It looks like someone else has come up with a better string representation in the interim anyway.
